evidence.reason: The handler converts every ValueError from require_canonical_delivery into a terminal stale record and marks the item done. That conflates a transient inability to read the delivery row with a confirmed ownership mismatch: once record.state is stale, the later pass at line 467 skips it, so even if the row becomes readable and still names this job, the already-completed result is never published. The unreadable case should remain retryable (without publishing) while a confirmed mismatch stays stale.
